LiHua discusses several games in the context of storytelling, but when it comes to playing with various storytelling tropes, she specifically mentions **"The Rings of Power"** series. In her conversation with Emily, LiHua expresses her fascination with the visuals and Lore exploration in "The Rings of Power," indicating that the series ties into the rich background of **The Lord of the Rings** novels. She is excited about the potential character development and backstories being woven into the series' narrative, which aligns with the use of storytelling tropes that are familiar to fans of Tolkien's work. This game is known for its immersive world-building and depth in character lore, characteristics that involve the use of various storytelling tropes to engage and expand on the universe of Middle-earth.
